profile.name: Tanishq Tiwari
profile.title: Software Development Engineer
profile.summary: Software Development Engineer with experience building payment workflows, backend services, and distributed systems using Go, Java, Kafka, Redis, and AWS.

experience.summary: Designed an asynchronous webhook delivery service in Go to isolate downstream dependencies from the transaction flow. Implemented a read-heavy microservice with configurable replica routing through AWS RDS Proxy.
highlights: Designed an asynchronous webhook delivery service in Go to isolate downstream dependencies from the transaction flow. Integrated Kafka for event ingestion, Redis-backed retry scheduling with exponential backoff, and AWS SQS dead-letter handling, achieving a 99.7% delivery success rate within 6 hours of the first attempt.
Implemented a read-heavy microservice with configurable replica routing through AWS RDS Proxy, reducing primary database load and improving query scalability during peak traffic.

experience.summary: Migrated critical payment workflows to direct JDBC-based database access, created an automated transaction recovery pipeline integrating BillDesk APIs, and engineered a configurable reminder service for recurring bill notifications.
highlights: Migrated critical payment workflows from an internal abstraction layer to direct JDBC-based database access, reducing query latency and eliminating an additional network hop.
Created an automated transaction recovery pipeline integrating BillDesk APIs to reconcile stuck transactions, driving daily failures down from over 1,500 to fewer than 20.
Engineered a configurable reminder service for recurring bill notifications with support for dynamic scheduling and filtering, increasing user engagement by 15%.

experience.summary: Integrated Razorpay UPI mandate flows, introduced OpenTelemetry-based distributed tracing and Sentry monitoring, and delivered low-latency loan eligibility services.
highlights: Integrated Razorpay UPI mandate flows into the transaction processing pipeline, improving authorization reliability and reducing payment failures.
Introduced OpenTelemetry-based distributed tracing and Sentry monitoring into a Node.js service, cutting debugging and incident resolution time by 40%.
Delivered low-latency loan eligibility services for pre-approved offers, contributing to a 20% increase in loan disbursement rates.
